liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Calls the stretch from Dark Star through the Caution reprise the core of the show and gripping listening; Says the Dark Star sections were mind-bending for the listener [3][12][13][14]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Heard The Other One followed by Cosmic Charlie from this show on the Grateful Dead radio channel, though Cosmic Charlie is not in the listed setlist [15]
- **Uncle John's Band Jam** (1 review): Says the Uncle John's Band jam was among the standout moments, along with the Dark Stars [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Uncle John's Jam**: rare: 5 archived performances [17]
- **Main Ten Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd69-11-08.sbd.wise.82.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 117 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1969-11-08.sbd.wise.17433.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 117 min; rated 3.12/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1969-11-08.178500..s2p.aud.pape.andrewf.flac2448**: audience recording; 5 songs; 32 min [3]. Said about its sound: This longer version sounds somewhat muffled [3]
- **gd69-11-08.weinberg.warner.26331.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 2 songs; 15 min; rated 3.33/5 by 9 [4]. Said about its sound: Considers it an excellent audience recording for such an early date, though regretting that only part of the show exists [11]

## Around the show

- Uploader recalls Dick Latvala staying at his home during Dicks Picks parties after they met in person [2]
- Notes that the whole show is already out as a soundboard on Dick's Picks 16, making this short audience fragment seem redundant [5]
- Argues the partial audience tape gives a different vantage on one of the evening's musical high points than the soundboard [6]
- Says the Dick's Picks 16 soundboard release sounds much better than this audience recording [9]
- Presents Dick's Picks 16 as another fine Fillmore show worth owning [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-11-08.sbd.wise.82.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jim Wise; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard from Dick Latvala's master reel, transferred to DAT, then processed in SoundForge by Jim Wise and extensively cleaned up [1]
- **gd1969-11-08.sbd.wise.17433.shnf**: transferred by Jim Wise; source: MR (Dick Latvala) > DAT > SoundForge (Jim Wise) > CD [2]. Also: Same seed as shnid 82, with tracks renamed to etree convention; Saint Stephen and the closing track labels were swapped to fix order [2]
- **gd1969-11-08.178500..s2p.aud.pape.andrewf.flac2448**: taped by John Pape; transferred by Andrew F; source: AUD (AKG D190 > Uher 4000L) Mono MAR > ? > 7-inch Reel, via the John Pape Collection, dubbed in the mid-70's. [3]. Also: Same audience recording as ID-26631, but a longer segment [3]
- **gd69-11-08.weinberg.warner.26331.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Marty Weinberg; transferred by Jack Warner; source: Audience: AKG 190E [4]. Also: Credits Marty Weinberg as the taper of this audience recording [11]
